description: A game for PrototypingGameEngine: the seam filled in, a project, and a game that already plays.

postActions.description: Three things the template cannot do for you

manualInstructions.text:
1. Add the project to PrototypingGameEngine.slnx, under the /src/Games/ folder, and a ProjectReference to it in the root Proto.fsproj.
2. Register it in src/Games.fs, which is the only file in the program that names more than one game.
3. Give it a suite: tests/<name>.fsx, loading a harness of its own and tests/Conforms.fsx, then Conforms.against. Name it in lower case and tools/tests.ps1 finds it; a capitalised .fsx is a harness and never runs on its own.

The game's own README.md has all three written out.
